How it works

Working Principle of Robotic Pick & Place Arm for Packaging

  • 1. Product Infeed & Detection Products are automatically transferred through synchronized conveyor systems and detected using intelligent sensors.
  • 2. Product Identification & Positioning Process Machine automatically identifies product position, orientation, and movement before robotic handling operation.

➜ Servo synchronized robotic motion ensures smooth handling and accurate placement operations.

  • 3. Robotic Pick & Place Operation Machine handles: ✔ Bottles ✔ Pouches ✔ Sachets ✔ Cartons ✔ Bags ✔ Jars ✔ Cans ✔ Industrial packaged products

accurately and continuously.

  • 4. Intelligent Product Handling Process Machine performs: Product picking Sorting Grouping Case packing Tray loading Carton loading Palletizing Transfer operations

for efficient packaging automation and warehouse handling operations.

  • 5. Vision & Automation Integration Optional systems include: Vision inspection systems Barcode scanning AI-based product recognition Robotic gripper systems Conveyor synchronization systems
  • 6. Finished Product Discharge Handled products discharged automatically for: Case packing Cartoning Palletizing Warehouse storage Export shipment operations
